added.summary: The probe's visible member, dump_entity's visible field and the dump_drawn action say why the main camera draws an entity or not at the current tick: drawn, hlod, hidden (naming the visible field), loading (naming the asset), layer, outside_view, untracked or nothing_to_draw, with how many of its drawables survived the cull. It runs on the CPU over the extracted frame, so it answers without a GPU.
capture_views captures one tick from up to 16 cameras in one call (position, target, up, fov or an orthographic height, near, far), without writing og.Camera.
